CustomObject.description: Junction letting one Opportunity belong to many Campaigns. Opportunity.CampaignId (Primary Campaign Source) holds a single value, so tagging a property into a second initiative used to mean overwriting the first: 196 of the 285 properties in the 2026 PAL/ROE refocus cohort already carried SAQ - 25+ MDU Project or ROE - 9-25 MDU Project. CampaignId is left alone as the ORIGINAL source and this object carries every membership, including a mirror of that original.
CustomObject.label: Opportunity Campaign
